description: Sequential retrieval audit covering all 19 route families, all five Engram skills, and six Engram memory-layer behaviors.

cases.question: What kinds of questions can you answer using the indexed aircraft manual?
Find part 120-20970-001 and cite its strongest source page.
I only remember that the part number contains 41824. Show the matching candidates and the source page for each candidate.
In ATA 25, find armrest-related parts and cite the strongest indexed source pages.
Find a locking ring used near the passenger seat and show source-backed candidates.
Search the illustrated parts list for part 120-41824-003. Report only source-backed item, nomenclature, quantity, and page fields. Clearly mark any field that is not proven.
Show the diagram or figure for part 120-41824-003 and cite the strongest visual source page.
How do I remove the passenger-seat armrest? Give only source-backed ordered steps and cite the page.
What warning, caution, or note applies to removing the passenger-seat armrest? Cite the source page.
Is part 120-20970-001 an approved replacement for 120-29067-001? Cite explicit authority evidence or say that none was found.
Where is part 120-41824-003 listed? Give the strongest page and any supporting locations.
What assembly relationship is explicitly supported for part 120-20970-001? Cite the supporting page or pages.
Find indexed pages about corrosion prevention and summarize only what the cited pages support.
Compare the indexed manual sources for part 120-41824-003 and report any source-backed differences.
Two indexed sources appear to disagree about part 120-41824-003. Resolve the contradiction from source evidence or state why it cannot be resolved.
The scan on page t_p_120_1176_p000085 is hard to read. Recover the readable text and clearly separate OCR guidance from confirmed source fields.
Show every indexed page mentioning part 120-41824-003, grouped by evidence type, and report coverage limits.
Find part 120-41824-003 and determine whether it is approved for installation.
Can you help me identify this?
Find a Recaro seat latch in the indexed manual and show only source-backed matches or clearly labeled candidates.
The part number starts with 120-4, but I do not know the rest. Rank the strongest candidates and explain why each matches.
Find part number 120-41824-003.
Find the component that locks or retains the passenger-seat armrest.
In ATA 25, find a seat buckle or restraint component and cite the strongest source-backed result.
